findings.title: Narrow isolated F5 seven-entry GDT
findings.assessment: Actual F3Context has five u64 entries and unchanged static TSS storage. Authorization permits a separate F5-only seven-entry table, not changing the original F3 layout or broadly revising predecessor behavior. Proposal correctly separates this from inherited paths.

findings.title: Preserve slots 0-4
findings.assessment: Copying the actual 40 bytes after successful F3 installation preserves null/code/data and actual busy normal/available emergency descriptors, rather than recreating stale available normal state. Require raw readback against originals before and after switch.

findings.title: DPL3 descriptor encoding
findings.assessment: Independently decoded 0x00cffb000000ffff/0x00cff3000000ffff: base0, effective limit0xffffffff, present DPL3 S1, accessed; readable nonconforming code and writable data; G1 D/B1 L0. Accessed bits already set avoid later accessed-bit mutations.

findings.title: Selectors and DPL/RPL
findings.assessment: Slot5/6 with TI0 and RPL3 derive selectors0x2b/0x33. Kernel0x08/0x10 and TSS0x18/0x20 stay unchanged. RPL alone does not grant USER access; appended DPL3 descriptors are necessary.

findings.title: GDTR size and identity backing
findings.assessment: Seven 8-byte descriptors require56 bytes and limit55; current F3 readback insists limit39. Proposal correctly calls original verifier before switch and requires F5-specific readback afterward, on permanently mapped supervisor image backing.

findings.title: TSS base/limit/busy state
findings.assessment: Actual descriptor() encodes full32-bit base and byte limit103; Tss is104 bytes. Copy after LTR must preserve access0x8b at slot3 and0x89 at slot4, bases referencing original objects. No TSS move or busy clearing.

findings.title: LTR order and reloads
findings.assessment: Original install executes LGDT/far kernel-CS reload, data/SS reload then LTR18. F5 extension follows successful original verification and must not invoke LTR again on busy descriptor. Retaining identical code/data and TSS bases leaves cached selectors valid; descriptor memory and actual hidden TR cache still require planned guest capture.

findings.title: Normal and emergency compatibility
findings.assessment: normal_state sets ESP0 transition top and SS0 kernel data; emergency_state uses separate supervisor stack/CR3 and f3_emergency_entry. Separate F5 table copies exact original descriptors and never rewrites TSS. Existing emergency code records hardware task ESP/TR/CR3/error and halts; no F5 frame decoding is valid there.

findings.title: IDT8 task gate
findings.assessment: Actual IDT8 wire value0x0000850000200000 is present DPL0 task gate to selector20. F5 excludes vector8 replacement and preserves slot4 meaning; installer must avoid generic IDT load which executes STI.

findings.title: Unchanged F3/F4 and shared F2 boundary
findings.assessment: Source-shared normalizer macro is compatible with supplied fixed68-byte entry contract if unchanged default F2 expansion/bridge and symbol identities survive modulo placement relocations. Exact common address is not necessary. This is not an already-tested CPL3 path: cross-ring hardware evidence remains mandatory. F5-only gates/private page path must not alter F3/F4 fixture entries; this is not authorization to rewrite shared serial or predecessor ABI.

findings.title: Exact IRETD frame
findings.assessment: 32-bit push order SS33,ESP40400000,EFLAGS2,CS2b,EIP produces low-to-high EIP/CS/EFLAGS/oldESP/oldSS, appropriate outer privilege return. Kernel validates scenario before user data-selector loads. No continuation, user pointer/length, or debugger EIP selection. Entry IF/DF/RF0 and IOPL0 are distinct from saved fault flags. Actual emitted operand sizes/launcher roots still must be checked.

findings.title: ESP0 and SS0 actual source
findings.assessment: Actual normal_state sets ESP0=TRANSITION_TOP=07c05000 and SS0=10, with supervisor transition range07c01000..07c05000. Actual Tss iomap104 exceeds descriptor limit103. CPL3 IOPL0 OUT must be denied; actual TSS/TR hidden-state readback is an implementation gate, not provided by this design review.

findings.title: F2 mandatory68-byte prefix
findings.assessment: Read actual PUSHAD and zero-extended DS/ES/FS/GS pushes and Rust offset assertions. Prefix remains17 u32 words: vector48,error52,EIP56,CS60,flags64; no optional fields may be appended. In cross-ring cases normalized vector address is ESP0-28, prefix ESP0-76; PUSHAD input prefix+48. Derived C entry07c04f9c mod16=12 includes alignment/argument/return.

findings.title: Conditional cross-ring tail gating
findings.assessment: The existing synthetic decoder accepts any nonzero origin and is explicitly not production; it cannot substitute for proposed exact RPL3/selector gate. Proposal requires exact frame ESP0-76 and low16 CS2b before reads at68/72, validates oldESP40400000 and low16 oldSS33, and never reads absent tail for same-ring/unsupported/nested/#DF paths. Unsupported21/29/30 are frame-independent in actual assembly.

findings.title: Payload bytes and addresses
findings.assessment: Parsed all six actual design hex strings independently. XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AX,CS; PUSH imm32 sentinel; POP EBX; STD is12 bytes. Decode B c6/05 absolute byte store40000800, C8b/0d absolute read07c01000, D f4 HLT, E e680 OUT80,AL, F8b/0d read403fe000. A first UD2 intended; every other opcode has UD2 fallback. Slots100,140,180,1c0,200,240 fit384 bytes ending280, separate from PREFIX0 and DATA800. Computed full expected page hash is derivation only, not guest capture; source default image is unchanged until an approved variant exists.

findings.title: Effective PDE/PTE permissions
findings.assessment: Actual install publishes code PTE P/U/runtime RO, stack PTE P/RW/U/runtime, then PDE256 P/RW/U last; table indices1..1022 absent, including guard1022. Validator compares PDE mask only A and leaves only A/D while checking supervisor inventory at both levels. C requires actual present supervisor PDE/PTE, not inferred virtual address; proposal correctly requires preflight refusal if mismatch. CR0.WP and classic non-PAE restrictions stay explicit; this proves no NX.

findings.title: Exact PF/GP error oracles
findings.assessment: Derived full PF B7=P/W/U, C5=P/U read of supervisor, F4=nonpresent USER read; CR2 exact40000800/07c01000/403fe000 respectively. A#UD6 zero synthetic error; D HLT CPL3 and E OUT IOPL0/no bitmap both #GP13 error0 at intended opcode. All32-bit equality rejects RSVD/fetch/PK/SS and reserved bits. Earlier IRET/segment faults or fallback UD2 are failures. I/O claim is architectural denial, not observed external hardware bus trace.

findings.title: Saved fault RF including exact positive/negative flags
findings.assessment: Independently derived flags RF10000+DF400+ZF40+PF4+fixed2=10446; AF undefined gives10456 only. Entry flags2 RF0 remains valid; fault-saved RF must1 for #UD/#PF/#GP. Source F2 oracle compares preflags|RF; F4 validator does likewise. Proposal02 now requires exactly10446/10456 and explicit RF0 rejection. Mirror SDM quote independently retrieved; older mirror section17.3.1.1 vs current F2 source20.3.1.1 is edition numbering, not conflicting semantics.

findings.title: Selector low16 with unconstrained CPU padding
findings.assessment: Proposal explicitly gates (CS&ffff)==2b before tail, compares (oldSS&ffff)==33, records raw high halves without constraint. Full33 remains valid for software-normalized selector pushes because xorEAX precedes16-bit segment MOVs. Actual CPU frame slots are u32 but padding is not selector semantics. Require synthetic nonzero-high-half and wrong-low16 rejection controls in existing named tests; do not count those as hardware.

findings.title: Required F and twelve rows
findings.assessment: F is explicitly required despite residual word proposed before its identity. Six distinct A-F identities times RAM128/512 require12 invocation-owned boots with same frozen candidate, actual CPL3 traces, physical frame/tables/descriptor captures, terminal IF0 HLT and no resumption. F4 actual REQUIRED is six Ring0 scenarios times two RAMs, not a substitute for F5. A prebaseline RED is sufficient only for explicit missing-CPL3 property (CS8/GDTR39), not execution of new payload; B-F characterization must not weaken security.

findings.title: Closed fourteen host identities
findings.assessment: Ten pure and four owner/publication names are now frozen with dedicated noncolliding module prefixes and gate1 exact --list enforcement; no identity deferral remains. This disposes the literal missing-name part of prior blocker F5-D01-TEST-IDENTITIES. Names/counts alone do not make owner tests effective: the pure-constants-only restriction and unlocated noninteger boundary are blockers below. Require actual emitted full libtest membership rather than guessing nested prefixes.

findings.title: Owner/publication tests must exercise actual production
findings.assessment: Proposal80 says owner module is included by tests_kernel only with pure constants, yet its four named tests claim before-publication copying, unchanged default output, real twelve-frame ownership/state and pre-acquisition refusal. Constants/decoder tests cannot establish these temporal/mutation properties. Actual user_arena::install performs byte initialization under cfg(not(test)) at200-206, then pins/leaves/final PDE at218-247; host tests currently skip byte copying entirely. Existing F4 tests invoke real prepare_f4_locked/install and inspect actual allocator ledger/PageMap mirrors with isolated processes. New F5 owner tests must explicitly use the real F5 preparation/publication helper and production-shared fixed-page initializer, with only physical backing/CPU observation substituted. Otherwise a model can pass while production copies late, omits payload or acquires extra leases. Planned guest captures are complementary, not permission to label constant-only tests as production owner proof.

findings.title: Real noninteger scenario boundary
findings.assessment: The frozen Rust owner test invalid_scenario_preflight_refusal promises non-integer preflight refusal before acquisition, while launcher accepts a kernel scalar literal1-6 and no dynamic kernel input interface is specified. A u32 register/parameter cannot carry a noninteger; casting/parsing first or constructing a synthetic constant decoder does not exercise production refusal. Proposed Python --scenario CLI has no frozen input grammar/type/rejection contract or link to this Rust identity. Must distinguish real raw CLI/JSON boundary (reject malformed/noninteger values before build/staging/process/preparation) from integer kernel boundary (0 and all values outside1-6 before try_admit/lease acquisition). Freeze accepted grammar and actual responsible parser/helper/tests, including Python bool if JSON numbers are admitted; do not add an arbitrary user pointer/length API merely to manufacture a noninteger test.

findings.assessment: Independently AST-parsed current F3_PREDECESSOR_GATES(70) and F4_GATES(2), parsed actual pinned F4 acceptance72 unique rows and recomputed raw hash. Multisets match exactly. Four distinct proposal names disjoint from predecessor imply76 proposed gates, not accepted gates. Gate1 covers full14 host membership plus fixture/harness contracts, gate2 production+fixture closure, gate3 twelve real F5 rows, gate4 fresh F1 ten rows; inherited F2/F3/F4 remain8/18/12. Existing regression timeout900 and F2 hardware300/F3,F4 hardware2100 remain untouched. Four new heavy gates capped900 require isolated feasibility; no calibration is claimed. Gate1 cannot be complete until blockers22/23 are resolved.

findings.title: Strict emitted closure and actual inherited F4 policy
findings.assessment: Read actual correction_cycle_01.audit and terminal_contract_02, not just GREEN metadata: conservative all-symbol-block arms, direct calls/tails/conditional branches, fallthrough, unresolved indirect rejection and forbidden panic/unwind/mutex/allocator/VGA symbols. Existing actual graph has4 blocks/11 edges/no forbidden or unresolved, including core atomic as_ptr (not store-order dispatcher), private UART and HLT marker. Mathematical infeasibility of panic arms is not a waiver. F5 proposal requires stricter instruction-level multi-root/fallthrough closure, production and fixture ELFs, supported/unsupported/nested/fail paths, fixed UART pointers/counts and no shared serial. Include #DF via architectural taskgate root and launcher finite IRET destinations/payloads separately; do not run inherited symbol-block walker unchanged or stop at labels. All executable reachable edges must decode/resolve; unknown/missing, indirect or forbidden edges fail. RET in a helper must be paired to finite known callsites; no return/resume to USER. An IRETD finite reviewed transition is the only proposed privileged transition exemption, not arbitrary indirect dispatch. Actual new closure/stack ledger remains future evidence.

findings.title: Predecessor, resource and authority constraints
findings.assessment: Actual retained owner inventory is12 leases; PageMap publication owns code/stack/table and leaves supervisor inventory unchanged. Proposal adds384 embedded bytes,56-byte GDT,record<=256 to existing image pages without owned frames; linker region2MiB..6MiB must still fit. Transition16KiB with512 budget gives15872 conditional headroom; emitted accounting must include first76 frame, align/call/scratch and one nested68-byte NMI until latch refusal, not just naked scratch<=64. Emergency2578/16384 remains inherited conditional bound, not new measurement. Preparing->Sealed->Terminal must freeze mutation; no unseal/retry/free/CR3 replacement/ordinary boot/shell. Preserve F1 final-readback historical gap, accepted/rejected F3/F4 provenance and exact input freeze; no timeout/profile/linker/shared-serial expansion. This review ran no builds/tests/guests and does not establish CPU readiness.
